profile.name: Irawan Agung Nugroho
profile.headline: Senior Backend Engineer & Golang Specialist
about: Senior Software Engineer with 15+ years building enterprise web, mobile, and cloud-native applications. I specialize in Golang backends, clean architecture, and distributed systems that handle real transaction volume.
I lead engineering teams through sprint planning, code review, and deployment management, turning business requirements into reliable, well-tested production systems.

research.narrative: My focus is designing backend systems that remain reliable under load: clean service boundaries, observable pipelines, and deployment workflows that teams can trust in production.

focus.name: Backend Engineering
focus.description: Golang and PHP backends with REST APIs, clean architecture, and microservices for enterprise-scale systems.

focus.name: Fullstack Development
focus.description: End-to-end application delivery with Next.js, React, React Native, and Laravel across web and mobile.

focus.name: Cloud & DevOps
focus.description: Containerized deployments with Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, and CI/CD pipelines for reliable releases.

focus.name: Team Leadership
focus.description: Sprint planning, code review, mentoring, and deployment management for engineering teams.
